description: Return the public IP address your request reaches WorldIP from, with the same profile lookup_ip gives (owner/ASN, country, region, city, reverse DNS; IPv4 also domains_hosted). Use it when the user asks for their own IP, ISP or location; for any other address call lookup_ip. On a hosted or cloud MCP client this is the platform's outbound IP, not the end user's device. If that address is private or reserved, the result is only the ip and a note, with no profile. Takes no arguments. Free and keyless, limited per calling IP to 60 calls a minute and 1,000 a UTC day (shared with the keyless JSON API); a limited call says when to retry.
name: whats_my_ip
title: What's my IP address
